metadata.title: SSPP – DNS Secure Zone Transfer
metadata.remarks: System Security & Privacy Plan template defining security, governance, and assurance requirements for DNS zone transfer (AXFR/IXFR) operations.

import-profile.remarks: Imports institutional baseline security and governance requirements applicable to privileged infrastructure services.

system-characteristics.system-description: Privileged DNS service enabling controlled transfer of authoritative DNS zone data between primary and secondary DNS servers or authorized external providers.

props.name: platform-capability
props.remarks: This SSPP governs DNS zone transfer operations (AXFR/IXFR).

props.name: usage-constraint
props.remarks: Zone transfer is strictly a control-plane function and MUST NOT be exposed for general resolution or application use.

props.name: non-equivalence-statement
props.remarks: Authorization to receive DNS zone data does not imply authority to resolve or publish DNS responses.

system-implementation.remarks: This SSPP defines security and governance expectations for DNS zone transfer. It introduces no independent DNS resolution or caching behaviors.

components.title: DNS Zone Transfer Governance
components.description: Defines authorization, integrity, and audit requirements for DNS zone transfers.

links.text: Relies on Secure-DNS for authoritative DNS behavior and trust boundaries.

components.title: Zone Transfer Authentication and Authorization
components.description: Defines how zone transfer endpoints authenticate and authorize each other.

components.title: Zone Transfer Integrity and Replay Protection
components.description: Ensures DNS zone data cannot be modified, replayed, or injected during transfer.

components.title: Zone Transfer Observability and Audit
components.description: Defines logging, monitoring, and audit requirements for zone transfer activity.

roles.title: DNS Zone Transfer Policy Authority
roles.remarks: Defines institutional policy, risk tolerance, and approval criteria for DNS zone transfer participation.

props.name: nice-work-role
props.remarks: Executive Cyber Leadership per NIST NICE Framework (SP 800-181).

roles.title: DNS Zone Transfer Architect
roles.remarks: Designs zone transfer topology, trust relationships, authentication mechanisms, and blast-radius boundaries.

props.name: nice-work-role
props.remarks: Security Architect per NIST NICE Framework.

roles.title: DNS Zone Transfer Operations
roles.remarks: Implements and operates approved zone transfer configurations, credentials, and lifecycle activities.

props.name: nice-work-role
props.remarks: Systems Administrator per NIST NICE Framework.

roles.title: DNS Zone Transfer Monitoring and Assurance
roles.remarks: Monitors zone transfer activity, detects anomalies, and supports investigations and assurance reviews.

props.name: nice-work-role
props.remarks: Security Operations Analyst per NIST NICE Framework.

control-implementation.remarks: Control satisfaction is achieved through enforced authorization, protected transfer channels, integrity validation, and auditability of zone transfer operations. This SSPP introduces no compensating controls.
